<!doctype html>
<html><body>
<script>
  let angle = Math.PI / 4;
  let velocity = 0;
  function step(dt) {
    const g = 9.81;
    const accel = -g * Math.sin(angle);
    velocity += accel * dt;
    angle += velocity * dt;
    if (angle > Math.PI) {
      angle -= 2 * Math.PI;
    } else if (angle < -Math.PI) {
      angle += 2 * Math.PI;
    }
    return angle;
  }
</script>
</body></html>
